title: Sumbangan Keperluan Asas Sarawak (SKAS) 2026
amount_note: Paid through S Pay Global for essential food.
paragraphs: An Anak Sarawak with identity-card status K who lives in Sarawak.
Recipient information is based on data from Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) 2026.
A household with income of RM5,000 or below.
A single adult aged 21 to 59, or a single person with a disability aged 19 to 59, with income of RM2,500 or below.
A senior aged 60 or older, without a spouse or eligible children, with income of RM5,000 or below.
There is no new application. Activate S Pay Global and acknowledge the claim before mid-December 2026. The next payment is 10 November 2026.

title: Domestic Electricity Discount
amounts: 25% for domestic users, April to December 2026
paragraphs: For a Sarawak Energy domestic customer on Tariff D. It does not cover a commercial property.
The discount applies to electricity used from April to December 2026. It is applied on the bill. No application is needed.
If a bill needs correcting, ask Sarawak Energy by 28 February 2027.

title: Bantuan Kewangan Khas (BKK) for IPT Students
amount_note: Paid twice a year through S Pay Global.
paragraphs: For a diploma or first-degree student at IPTA or IPTS. There is no income cap.

title: Free Laptop
unspecified: A laptop is given in kind. The page does not state a cash amount.
paragraphs: For a first-year diploma or bachelor student. Family income per person must be RM1,500 or below.

title: Book Voucher
amount_note: For Foundation through PhD. There is no income cap.
paragraphs: Book aid for an IPT student, paid through S Pay Global.

title: Inisiatif Graduan Pulang Sarawak (IGPS)
amount_note: Claim within 60 days of the flight.
paragraphs: A flight subsidy back to Sarawak for a full-time student aged 18 or older who is studying outside Sarawak. At least one parent must be Sarawakian.
Apply online to Yayasan Sarawak. Applications stay open through the year.

title: Geran Kemasukan IPT
amount_note: Family income per person must be RM1,500 or below.
paragraphs: A grant for the first semester of a certificate, matriculation, foundation, pre-diploma, diploma or bachelor programme. At least one parent must be Sarawakian.
Apply online to Yayasan Sarawak. Applications stay open through the year.

title: Selected-Course Tuition Waiver at Four Institutions
amounts: RM15,000 a year, only if income per person is RM1,500 or below
amount_note: The stipend is RM5,000 for lodging and RM10,000 through S Pay Global.
paragraphs: A tuition waiver for selected courses at Swinburne, Curtin, UTS and i-CATS.
There is no separate application. The university forwards the names.

title: HDAS Deposit Assistance
amounts: Deposit of 10%, or a maximum of RM10,000
paragraphs: A deposit for a first home, for a B40 or M40 buyer. Buy an affordable home from a registered developer, or build on SPK or SPS land.
Apply through Mutiara on 082-313035.

title: SRAS Rent Assistance
paragraphs: For an IPTA or IPTS student renting in Kuching, Samarahan, Sibu, Bintulu or Miri.
The form also covers a PPR tenant with identity-card status K and income of RM4,556 or below.
Apply online.

title: Rumah Spektra Permata
amount_note: This is the price and the income band, not a cash grant.
paragraphs: An affordable home for a married applicant or a single parent aged 18 to 65 who does not already own a house or land.
Financing is through Mutiara Mortgage & Credit.

title: Sri Pertiwi
unspecified: This is an affordable house, not a cash payment. Selling-price caps are not listed here.
paragraphs: Household income up to RM10,000.

title: Senior Citizen Health Benefit (SCHB)
amounts: Up to RM500 a person a year
amount_note: Cashless outpatient treatment at panel clinics.
paragraphs: For a person with identity-card status K, aged 60 or older, with household income of RM7,000 or below, and no other outpatient cover.
Apply online on Service Sarawak.

title: Kenyalang Gold Card (KGC)
unspecified: Participating merchants give discounts. The rates are not listed here.
paragraphs: For a person with identity-card status K, aged 60 or older, who lives in Sarawak. You are included automatically.
Activate the card online. The virtual card is in SarawakPass.

title: Bantuan Ihsan Kematian (BIK)
amounts: RM1,800 to the next of kin
amount_note: For the family of a Kenyalang Gold Card holder who has died.
paragraphs: For the registered next of kin. The person who died must not have received a JPA death benefit, and must not have lived in a government institution.
Apply online through Service Sarawak within 4 months of the death.

title: Bantuan Ibu Bersalin (BIB)
paragraphs: For a Malaysian mother with identity-card status K, or the wife of a Malaysian with status K. The birth can be in or outside Sarawak. Gestation of at least 22 weeks.
Apply within 3 months of the delivery. You need SarawakPass and S Pay Global. Apply on iSarawakCare.

title: Endowment Fund Sarawak (EFS)
amount_note: Apply online within 1 year of the birth. A child born overseas who has no MyKid yet must use the manual form and email it to efs@sarawak.gov.my.
paragraphs: For a birth or adopted child. A parent must be Malaysian with identity-card status K. The child can be born in or outside Sarawak.
Apply on Service Sarawak. The money can be withdrawn at age 18 with MyKad at the bank.

title: Bantuan Ketua Isi Rumah Wanita (KIRWaS)
amount_note: Service Sarawak and JWKS both state RM1,000. Their income tests differ. Use the page you apply on.
paragraphs: For a Sarawakian woman aged 18 or older with identity-card status K, or the wife of a status K holder. She is a single mother or the female head of the household, and she is not already on welfare aid.
Service Sarawak: household income from RM1,169 to RM4,849. Apply on iSarawakCare, or submit the form to JWKS.
JWKS: a woman already in business, with household income of RM2,618 or below. Apply through JWKS.

title: Sarawak Micro Credit Scheme (SMCS)
amount_note: Type 1 is for B40 borrowers. Agriculture is excluded.
paragraphs: A micro-credit loan for a Sarawakian whose business has run in Sarawak for at least 6 months. It can be used for working capital, renovating a premises, or buying machinery.
Apply online, or at SEDC or Agrobank.

title: Geran Pelancaran / Modal Mikro
amount_note: One-off startup capital for a JKMS client.
paragraphs: For a JKMS client who is still able to work, with income at or below the current poverty line. Apply on iSarawakCare or at a JKMS office.

title: Bantuan Am (BA)
paragraphs: State welfare aid. Apply at a JKMS office.

title: Bantuan Belia-Beliawanis (BBB)
paragraphs: State aid for youth. Apply at a JKMS office.
